intent: Write two specific reasonable female stage-props duties, preserving role identity and accurate alternative sentence patterns.
picturePurpose: Coded sentence-repair and duty-comparison cards separate verb forms, specific content and task requirements; no decorative image needed.

workshop.title: 把职责写成完整句子
workshop.instruction: 先修职责句，再把两件事接清楚，最后核对岗位与2—4句要求。可以写其他合理职责，不必照抄参考。

items.label: 同一职责，有两种完整写法
items.prompt: 选一种句式，再把职责写完整。
items.reason: 示例职责句的结构已核对。自己的职责内容可以合理替换。
items.hint: She checks用第三人称单数；She is responsible for后接名词或动词-ing。两种句式都能介绍职责。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。在职业分享中介绍一位舞台道具工作人员。说明她做的两件事，不要把她说成台上的演员。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 职责句改写台
composeBrief.hint: 句式变了，动词形式也要一起检查。
composeBrief.wrong: 两种句式都可用，但要配所选结构：She checks不能漏-s；She is responsible for后接checking，不能混搭动词形式。

choices.label: She checks the props before the show.
She is responsible for checking the props before the show.
She check the props before the show.

items.label: 两项职责，要有两件具体的事
items.prompt: 哪组内容确实写清两项不同的道具职责？
items.reason: 两件具体工作已区分。自己的职责可以换，只要符合道具岗位。
items.hint: 反复说她很负责，不等于列出两项职责。检查、确认变化、按清单准备、归位都可以合理选择。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。在职业分享中介绍一位舞台道具工作人员。说明她做的两件事，不要把她说成台上的演员。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 职责内容卡
composeBrief.hint: 数的是不同工作，不是有几个形容词。
composeBrief.wrong: 两项职责要是不同的具体工作，不能重复同一检查或改成演员。also这句补充了询问变动；because这句只解释检查理由，but这句仍在说同一次检查。

choices.label: She checks the props. She checks the same props again.
She prepares the props on the list. She puts them back after the show.
She plays the leading role. She sings the final song.

fields.label: 哪句明确补充另一项职责？

choices.label: She also asks the actors about changes.
She checks the props because the show starts soon.
She checks the props, but some need another check.

items.label: 写完回看岗位与句数
items.prompt: 哪项是这道写作题必须保留的？
items.reason: 岗位、职责与写作形式已核对。接下来完成自己的2—4句并自查。
items.hint: 2—4句英文，不是两个词组；两项合理道具职责，不是必须照抄某两句话。她是道具工作人员，不能改写成演员。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。在职业分享中介绍一位舞台道具工作人员。说明她做的两件事，不要把她说成台上的演员。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 交稿前核对卡
composeBrief.hint: 参考的物品和具体做法可以换；岗位与任务形式不能换。
composeBrief.wrong: 岗位要保留为幕后道具工作，不能换成演员或观众；成稿还需2—4句完整英文，关键词笔记或只说不写都不够。

choices.label: She works with stage props behind the scenes.
She plays the main character on stage.
She watches the show as a member of the audience.
Two to four written English sentences with two reasonable duties.
Only notes such as checking props; putting props away.
Only an oral outline without writing the sentences.

transfer.stem: Which outline fits this new written introduction?
transfer.passage:
A different backstage introduction
Write two to four English sentences introducing a female theatre sound worker. Give two reasonable duties and keep her role distinct from acting. The exact duties are for you to propose.

options.text: She works with theatre sound. She checks the microphones before the show. She checks those microphones again when she finishes the first check.
She works with theatre sound. She checks the microphones before the show. She also plays the leading character and speaks the character’s lines on stage.
She works with theatre sound. She checks the microphones before the show. She also confirms the sound cues with the team before the performance.
She works with stage props. She checks the stage objects before the show. She also puts the props back in their places after the performance.

answer.display: She works with theatre sound. She checks the microphones before the show. She also confirms the sound cues with the team before the performance.

explanation.strategy: 新岗位先换对，再检查具体职责与句子结构。

steps.text: 这次写音响工作人员，两项职责要与声音设备或演出音响配合有关。
steps.reason: 检查麦克风、确认声音提示是合理示例；自己的其他合理职责也可以。

steps.text: 写2—4句，保持她是幕后工作人员，不把她改成演员。
steps.reason: 两个岗位名或一句评价，不能代替两项职责的完整介绍。

distractors.reason: 虽然写了三句，但后两句都在说检查同一组麦克风，没有两项不同职责。
保留了一项音响职责，却把第二项工作改成扮演角色，混淆了幕后岗位与演员。
两项道具职责本身合理，但没有更新为新题的音响岗位。

explanation.pitfall: 句子语法正确，还要看职责是否属于新岗位。

visual.title: 新岗位与职责对齐
visual.caption: 先核对内容，再核对句子；不照抄旧任务。
